scope.colRootAudit: No exact COL26.8 usage node named Radiolaria exists in the complete pinned hierarchy; no strict COL partition is claimed.
scope.boundary: This boundary audit contains no Radiolaria rows: COL26.8 has no exact Radiolaria node, and ITIS 2026-08-26 has no accepted exact Radiolaria root. Its only exact-name valid order is a legacy Labyrinthulea/Piroplasmia placement with no accepted species descendants. Accepted Rhizaria is recorded only as a nearby modern classification candidate and is not substituted.

rootBoundaryAudit.decision: No exact accepted Radiolaria root exists in either pinned authority. The ITIS exact-name order TSN 46088 is a valid legacy record under Labyrinthulea/Piroplasmia with no accepted species descendants; accepted Rhizaria TSN 969913 is a nearby modern classification record, not a substitute root. No COL or ITIS range is asserted.

partitionOverlapAudit.decision: The exact-root contract produces no Radiolaria COL usage IDs and no accepted ITIS current-species TSNs. It therefore overlaps none of the audited Protists and Chromists sidecars, including Cercozoa, Foraminifera, Bigyra, Ochrophyta, Oomycota, Perkinsozoa and Labyrinthulomycetes.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

evidenceBoundary.en: This CC0 ITIS boundary audit is a frozen exact-root check for the declared COL26.8 Protists and Chromists package. It is not a global Radiolaria checklist, a final classification authority, a phylogeny, a species-concept equivalence assertion, a biological dossier or a scientific-review record.
